title: Austin: Official Greeter, Land Deals & Tax Breaks
summary:
*   **Official City Greeter Appointed:** John Hornsby was recognized for his public service and famous "You are Mighty Welcome to Your Capital City" greeting, officially appointed as an "Official Greeter."
*   **Lifetime Land Use Agreement:** The city authorized a unique contract allowing an individual, A. A. Shaw, to use and occupy two city lots for their lifetime.
*   **Tax Penalty and Interest Remission:** The city council approved a resolution to remit penalties and half of the accrued interest on unpaid property taxes for a specific owner, citing it as "just and equitable."

The following resolution was submitted:
(RESOLUTION)
WHEREAS, the Honorable County Judge and County Commissioners of Travis County on June 16,
A. D. 1945, unanimously adopted and signed a resolution complimenting and commending John
Hornsby for his long and splendid record of outstanding public service and his originating
the greeting "You are Mighty Welcome to Your Capital City", and elected him as an official
greeter; and WHEREAS, after reading said resolution, we heartily endorse it because we
consider it timely and well deserved; now, therefore, BE IT RESOLVED that we, the
undersigned, hereby appoint John Hornsby an Official Greeter for our most beautiful and
friendliest Capital City.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Ayes : Councilmen Alford, Bartholomew,
Gillis, Mayor Miller Noes : None
Absent: Councilman Wolf
